title: Where the next 100 MW of home batteries is worth the most in ERCOT
independent: Independent analysis. Not affiliated with Base Power, ERCOT, or a utility.
vintage: Day-ahead settlement point prices, ERCOT NP4-190-CD report type 12331, delivery dates 2026-09-27 through 2026-10-28. Zones from the settlement-point list NP4-160-SG. Shadow prices NP4-191-CD report type 12332, same delivery dates.

method.basis: Resource-node day-ahead settlement point price minus the settlement load zone price, same delivery date, hour ending, and DST flag.
method.rank: 95th percentile of that basis, descending. Mean basis and the share of hours at least $20/MWh above the zone are reported beside it.
method.zone_reason: Public Base sources name ADER participation in load zones Houston, North, and South. The Inside Base post and the 11 August 2026 DSWG deck do not name LZ_LCRA or LZ_AEN. Those NOIE zones are omitted from the ranking.
method.season: Omitted. The public nodal day-ahead list is about a month, and this extract is one autumn window.

map.note: Map omitted, so the state outline was not required.

notes: Live MIS refresh skipped. Cached files only.

historical_hubs_only.reason: NP4-180-ER (13060) and the real-time hub and load-zone archive (13061) publish hubs and load zones, not resource nodes.

hifld.note: Match is a unique normalized substation name. Ambiguous HIFLD names were dropped. No coordinate was interpolated.

sources.detail: Inside Base. August 2026 fleet chart names North, South, and Houston ADER partitions. The 5127__A example is a West Texas import path.

findings: From 2026-09-27 through 2026-10-28 (32 delivery dates, 768 hours), the largest 95th-percentile basis in Houston, North, and South was RHESS2_ESS1 in LZ_SOUTH, substation GEORSO: $64.31/MWh. Mean $10.62/MWh. 16.4% of hours cleared at least $20.00/MWh above the zone. The node price reached $100.00/MWh in 73 hours.

By zone: LZ_HOUSTON led with CR_RN at a 95th percentile of $43.73/MWh (mean $7.73/MWh, 768 hours). LZ_NORTH led with JUNG_SLR_RN at a 95th percentile of $60.70/MWh (mean $11.09/MWh, 768 hours). LZ_SOUTH led with RHESS2_ESS1 at a 95th percentile of $64.31/MWh (mean $10.62/MWh, 768 hours). Most nodes sit close to the zone. LZ_HOUSTON median $6.36 (217 nodes); LZ_NORTH median $2.48 (219 nodes); LZ_SOUTH median $6.16 (338 nodes). 42 of 774 reached $20.00/MWh at the 95th percentile. Same files, outside the rank: KNAPP_RN in LZ_WEST at $196.68/MWh. At RHESS2_ESS1 the highest block was afternoon, $103.21/MWh over 192 hours.

GEORSO has no positive shadow-price row in this window, so the RHESS2_ESS1 basis is a price gap without a same-name constraint. PAVLOV (PAVLOV_BT_RN and PAVLOV_RN) is named on 469 positive rows, sum $14,099.70, including BLESSI_PAVLOV1_1, LAN_CT_PAVLOV1_1. Constraint 5127 does not appear in this day-ahead shadow-price extract. The largest shadow-price sum was 6437__F, SCRCV to KNAPP: 958 rows, sum $94,696.80. No map. Unique HIFLD names matched 41 of 774 substations and 2 of the top 15. Unmatched nodes were left unplaced.
